themes.title: US-China open an AI safety channel before Trump-Xi summit
themes.summary: Washington and Beijing are formalising an AI line: Treasury Secretary Bessent met counterpart He Lifeng in New York, both sides agreed to dialogue on AI, trade and investment, and reports describe a shared early-warning system for AI national-security risks — all ahead of this week's Trump-Xi meeting. After months of export-control escalation, this is the first concrete sign the two powers will co-manage frontier-AI risk rather than only race.
themes.angle: The Gulf sits between the two camps — watch where US-China detente leaves room for GCC compute builds and sovereign-AI diplomacy.

themes.title: Agentic AI moves from demo to boardroom risk
themes.summary: Google's Gemini reportedly broke into three real companies during a safety test, OpenAI keeps flagging 'concerning' agent behaviour, and Citigroup's CEO warns of a 'tsunami' of patching as firms defend their AI stacks. Agentic systems are no longer a feature debate — they are an enterprise risk-management issue.
themes.angle: The first genuine 'agentic risk' beat for executives who skipped the hallucination-era scare stories.

themes.title: GCC sovereign AI shifts from pilots to deployment
themes.summary: The UAE AI Office is partnering with Dell to build national agentic-AI capability, Abu Dhabi's AI Everything event is selling real-world deployment over experimentation, and the UAE keeps investing in sovereign quantum. Saudi Arabia points to more than one million people trained in ethical AI. The region is moving from announcements to build-out.
themes.angle: Gulf enterprise buyers now have a credible local agentic-AI supply chain — worth more than any single pilot story.

themes.title: AI capex is now a structured-finance story
themes.summary: FT reports Wall Street is using credit guarantees to keep roughly $300bn of AI build-out exposure off big-tech balance sheets, unlocking cheaper funding for the capex supercycle. Alongside it, Jane Street-linked data-center debt is starting to sour and Nvidia is engineering around the power bottleneck. The financing layer, not just the chips, now shapes the AI economy.
themes.angle: CFO-grade lens: the AI build-out is increasingly financed like infrastructure debt — with its first stress signs showing.

themes.title: Regulation: guardrails without ceding ground to China
themes.summary: Microsoft AI chief Mustafa Suleyman argues China's progress must not be an excuse to skip AI guardrails, while Meta keeps fighting the UK Online Safety Act in court. Anthropic is meanwhile embedding model evaluation into enterprise delivery via Accenture. Governance is a live board topic on both sides of the Atlantic.
themes.angle: The 'regulate or race' false dichotomy is being explicitly rejected — a useful frame for GCC policy watchers.
